subject: what are the differences by exchanging the order of geom and stat

messages.author: 83902f16f5e31688
messages.subject: what are the differences by exchanging the order of geom and stat
parts:
in the ggplot2 book, "ggplot2 Elegant Graphics for Data Analysis", there are two plots at page60, and fig4.9.

I use two ways to create them, but get different result as follows:

p<-ggplot(diamonds,aes(x=clarity))

#1
p+geom_line(aes(y=..count.., ymax=..count.., group=cut, position="identity"),stat="bin")

#2
p+stat_bin(aes(y=..count.., ymax=..count.., group=cut, position="identity"),geom="line")

so I wonder why the #1 and #2 give different result. Does the order of geom and stat matter?

Thanks.

messages.author: 245e7a1097391518
messages.subject: Re: what are the differences by exchanging the order of geom and stat
parts:
Hi. I think the problem is that the position= argument should not be within the aes parameters but outside it. Since the default position for geom_line is "identity", this really doesn't matter but the default position for stat_bin is "stacked" and so it does in that case.

if you do the following, the plots should be the same (I also added a color aesthetic):

    p+geom_line(aes(y=..count.., ymax=..count.., group=cut, color=cut),stat="bin", position="identity")  [Again, this is the default position]

    p+stat_bin(aes(y=..count.., ymax=..count.., group=cut, color=cut),geom="line", position="identity")  [Override default position]

Regards,
Rich

messages.subject: Re: what are the differences by exchanging the order of geom and stat
parts:
Hi, 

Although I am not an expert in ggplot2, my first guess is that the difference is caused by not the order of stat and geom but the position = "identity". As the position is usually not an aesthetic variable, it does nothing inside of the aes() parentheses, and the default value of position is stacked, thus, during the call your position variable will be overwritten. 

Compare

and #3
p+stat_bin(aes(y=..count.., ymax=..count.., group=cut), position="identity", geom="line")

By geom_line the default position is identity, this is why you cannot see the phenomenon there.
